title: Forces and motion: calculation set (20 marks)
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Review of Key Stage 3 and working scientifically (9C)
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 56 (Forces calculation set (20 marks) and mark scheme (portal))
intro: Answer every question. Show working and units for calculations. Mark it with the mark scheme.

questions.q: A cyclist travels 1,200 m in 240 s. Calculate the speed.
A car travels at 15 m/s for 40 s. How far does it go?
Forces of 30 N right and 12 N left act on a box. Find the resultant force.
Calculate the weight of a 70 kg person on Earth (g = 10 N/kg).
Calculate the weight of the same person on the Moon (g = 1.6 N/kg).
A force of 20 N acts 0.3 m from a pivot. Calculate the moment.
A 600 N crate rests on 0.2 m². Calculate the pressure.
A spring stretches 4 cm with a 2 N load. How far will it stretch with 5 N (within its limit)?
questions.a: 0.5 N per cm, so 5 N gives 10 cm (2)

questions.q: Explain why a sharp knife cuts better than a blunt one.
questions.a: Smaller area (1) for the same force gives greater pressure (1)

questions.q: A balanced see-saw has a 400 N child 1.5 m from the pivot. How far from the pivot must a 600 N adult sit?
